title: Gemini Skills Replace Gems: Key Dates and the Workspace Delay
desc: Google began rolling out Gemini skills on October 13 but delayed skills in Workspace. Gems end for business accounts no sooner than March 1, 2027. What to do.
keywords: gemini skills, gemini skills vs gems, gemini gems retirement, are gemini gems going away, workspace studio ask a gem, gemini skills workspace delay, migrate gems to skills, gemini skills rollout
cta: Need your Gem-based automations rebuilt before March?
body:
October 14, 2026. Google started rolling out skills in the Gemini app on October 13, with completion expected by mid-November, and the same day put the rollout of skills inside Workspace apps on hold until further notice. Skills replace Gems. For business and enterprise accounts, Gems stop working no sooner than March 1, 2027, and Workspace Studio flows that use an Ask a Gem step stop with them. You can already no longer create a Studio flow with an Ask a Gem step, so teams that automate Gmail and Drive work in Studio are between tools until the Workspace rollout resumes.

What Google changed, and when

  1. September 30. Google introduced skills, reusable instructions for Gemini built on the Markdown-based SKILL.md standard, and said they will replace Gems. From then on, new Workspace Studio flows cannot use the Ask a Gem step. Existing flows keep working.
  2. October 5. Skills began rolling out inside Workspace. Rapid Release domains were due to finish by October 12, and Scheduled Release domains were due to start on October 19.
  3. October 13. Skills began rolling out in the Gemini app, and Google posted an update saying both Workspace rollouts are delayed until further notice, with a new timeline to follow.
  4. November 17. Gems move to the Settings panel of the Gemini app. You can still create, edit and use them there.
  5. No sooner than March 1, 2027. For business and enterprise accounts, Gems can no longer be created, edited or used, Ask a Gem steps stop working, and remaining Gems are auto-migrated to draft skills in the Gemini app. Education accounts follow no sooner than June 1, 2027. Android Central reports the same dates.

Who gets skills, and where

Skills in the Gemini app are available to all Google Workspace customers and to personal Google accounts, according to Google's post. Skills inside Workspace, which Google's Workspace Studio help page says you can create in Studio and use in flows and in the Gemini side panel of Gmail, Chat, Docs and Slides, are limited to Business Starter, Standard and Plus, Enterprise Starter, Standard and Plus, Google AI Pro for Education and the AI Expanded Access add-on, and to users over 18. The two do not sync: a skill made in the Gemini app has to be recreated in Workspace before you can use it there. Your Workspace admin also controls whether you can use skills at all.

What it means for teams that automate with Gems

  1. Do not plan new automations around Gems. A new Studio flow cannot use the Ask a Gem step, and the skill steps meant to replace it are part of the delayed Workspace rollout. Anything that has to ship this month needs another route.
  2. List what depends on Gems. Write down every Studio flow with an Ask a Gem step and every Gem your team relies on, with an owner for each. The business deadline is no sooner than March 1, 2027, and Google says admins will get details of the auto-migration at least 30 days in advance.
  3. Rewrite your Gems as skills in the Gemini app now. That is Google's own migration path, and it is the part that is rolling out. Because skills follow the SKILL.md format, Google says skills you built on other platforms can be copied into the Gemini app and Workspace.

If a flow answers customers or leads, it should not depend on a feature that is mid-migration. Our AI automation team builds those flows on tools with stable APIs, and an n8n developer can rebuild a Gmail flow outside Studio. If the flow sends from Gmail, the mailbox's reputation still decides whether replies land; that is what our email infrastructure service fixes. For the other Workspace AI change this week, see our note on Google Meet follow-up email drafts, and for the Studio limits that still apply, our guide to Workspace Studio Gmail reply automation.
faqs: Skills are reusable custom instructions for Gemini, built on the Markdown-based SKILL.md standard. Unlike Gems, several skills can be stacked in one chat, and they work inside the Gemini app and, once Google resumes the Workspace rollout, inside Workspace apps and Workspace Studio flows. Google says skills will replace Gems.

Gems move to the Settings panel of the Gemini app on November 17, 2026 and keep working there. For business and enterprise accounts, Gems can no longer be created, edited or used no sooner than March 1, 2027, and remaining Gems are auto-migrated to draft skills. Education accounts follow no sooner than June 1, 2027.
Why can't I see skills in Gmail or Docs yet?

On October 13, 2026 Google delayed the rollout of skills inside Workspace apps until further notice. Skills in the Gemini app began rolling out the same day, with completion expected by mid-November. Skills in Workspace also need an eligible edition, such as Business Starter, Standard or Plus, and your admin's permission.
Do Workspace Studio flows with an Ask a Gem step still work?

Yes, for now. Existing flows with an Ask a Gem step keep working, but you can no longer create new flows with that step. For business and enterprise accounts, those flows stop working no sooner than March 1, 2027.
